slides.headline: 2) CUT VENDOR COSTS WITH ONE EMAIL
slides.body: It found 3 vendors charging 40% above market rate. He sent the emails Claude wrote and saved $2,200 a month.

slides.headline: 3) FIND WHICH CLIENTS COST MORE THAN THEY PAY
slides.body: One consultant found 4 clients generating 80% of her stress and only 12% of her revenue. In a stagflation economy, the ones eating your time without paying go first.
That is the 30-year treasury rate right now, the highest since the run-up to the 2008 financial crisis. If you carry business debt, your cost of operating just went up.

slides.headline: 4) WRITE THE PRICE RAISE EMAIL THAT KEEPS CUSTOMERS
slides.body: A B2B software founder needed to raise prices 18%. He avoided it for three weeks, gave Claude the context, sent the email in 20 minutes, and lost zero clients.

slides.headline: 5) FIND WHAT TO AUTOMATE BEFORE YOU HIRE
slides.body: A business owner was about to pay $55,000 a year for an admin hire. Claude found 70% of the tasks could be automated tonight. She did not hire.

slides.headline: 6) BUILD YOUR 90-DAY STAGFLATION PLAN IN ONE PROMPT
slides.body: A bakery owner spent 45 minutes with Claude walking through his cost structure. He came out with a plan to survive 12 months without laying anyone off.

caption:
Swipe through and save this. Six AI prompts that protect your business when prices keep rising and customers slow down. 💰

Slide 2 finds if you are already selling at a loss, slide 3 gives you vendor negotiation emails ready to send, slide 4 spots which clients cost more than they pay, slide 5 shows the economic pressure behind all of this, slide 6 writes the price increase email that keeps your customers, slide 7 finds what to automate before your next hire, slide 8 builds your full 90-day plan in one prompt.

BofA is forecasting stagflation for the next 12 months. The 30-year rate just hit 5.30%, highest since the run-up to 2008. Most business owners will wait until they feel the squeeze. The ones running these prompts tonight will already have a plan.
Running a business? DM us "AI" and we will show you what this could do for yours.
